newsitem.title: PERU: General Motors says reentering Peru mkt.
newsitem.headline: General Motors says reentering Peru mkt.

text.p: General Motors Corp said late Wednesday it planned to reenter the Peruvian automobile market after an absence of two decades by initially selling its line of Chevrolet vehicles.
The U.S. car manufacturer said it was returning to Peru because of the country's economic growth that has seen a 4.8 percent year-on-year gross domestic product rise in the first quarter this year.

"The corporation decided to reenter the Peruvian market because the conditions of constant economic growth have turned Peru into one of the most attractive markets for investors," Francisco Stefanelli, general manager of General Motors Peru, said in a statement.
